items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well he was in the band when Joe Avery was in the band at that time

ctx.x: Charlie Love was in that one time.
Well he was in the band when Joe Avery was in the band at that time, then he got rid of

And he got Emma Barry playing piano in the trombone plays. Well that's what makes it complicated when they have a band, how many different fellas playing that same band under the same name. Well they say, did you ever play with Kid Rene? Yeah I did at certain various times. Well I saw the band and I saw Faye Sowe playing with them, I saw Joe Rene. But I did play too at certain times the same way they play. I mean that would make it complicated to say well how do you say he played with them and then somebody else,…
